title: Verify: Frame classes, four-state Button and framed screen components render
summary: Unit tests for frameKit, Frame, Button states and wiring
description: Test generated CSS objects and rendered classes with stores mocked as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Frame classes include borderImage and pixelated
Header, layout, story panel carry frame classes

steps.symbol: it('frame classes use border-image and pixelated')
steps.action: Call frameComponentClasses(); for each of bar, panel, plaque, parchment, slot assert key '.sf-frame-<name>' has imageRendering 'pixelated' and borderImage containing the FRAME_KIT file name and its slice. Assert keys '.sf-btn', '.sf-btn:disabled', ".sf-btn[data-state='hover']" and ".sf-btn[data-state='pressed']" exist with different borderImage values.

Render <Button variant='frame' state=S> for S in normal, hover, pressed, disabled with testing-library; assert each has class 'sf-btn' and data-state S, and the disabled one has the disabled attribute. Render <Frame kind='panel'> and assert class sf-frame-panel.

steps.symbol: it('game screen components apply the kit')
steps.action: Render GameLayout with header, scene, story nodes; assert aside has class sf-frame-panel. Render HeaderOverlay with worldTitle 'W' and no round after resetting useUiStore via setState; assert the header has sf-frame-bar and the Settings button has sf-btn. Render StoryPanel with an inventory of one item and assert the item li has sf-frame-slot and the Dialogue region has sf-frame-parchment (use props shape from src/components/StoryPanel.tsx).
